spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Obscured, dimmed, darkened.
E.
रुच् to be light, घञ् affix; अ neg. prefix.

mfn. (-दत्-दती-दत्)
Having black or discoloured teeth.
E.
अरोक, and दत् for दन्त a tooth, also अरोकदन्त.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Having bad teeth; see the last.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Well, healthy, free from disease.
m. (-गः)
Health.
E.
अ neg. रोग sickness.

f. (-ता)
Health.
E.
अरोगिन् well, तल् affix, or with त्व अरोगित्वं.

mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
Well, in health.
E.
अ neg. रोगिन् sick.

f. (-कः)
Indigestion, loss of appetite.
E.
अ neg. रोचक digestion.

Disagreeable.
2

Dark.
3

Ugly.
E.
अ neg. रोचिष्णु splendid, &c.

n. (-नं)
Not weeping.
E.
अ neg. रोदन weeping.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
Unobstructed, unobstructable.
E.
अ neg. रोध्य to be hindered.

n. (-णं)
Not planting or fixing.
E.
अ neg. रोपण setting up.

n. (-णं)
1 Trusting, delivering.
2 Placing or fixing in or on.
3

Elevating.
4

Planting.
5

The bending of a bow.
E.
आङ् before रुह to ascend, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-षः)
Calmness, gentleness.
E.
अ neg. रोष wrath.

n. (-ग्यं)
Health.
E.
आङ् reverse, रुज to be sick, यञ् aff.

mfn. (-ढा-ढ्री-ढृ)
Who or what mounts or rides, &c.
E.
आङ् before रुह to mount, affix तृच्.

m. (-पः)
1 Placing in or on.
2 Assigning or attributing to.
E.
आङ् before रुह to mount, causal form, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Deposited, intrusted.
2 Placed, fixed.
3

Made.
4

Raised, elevated.
5

Consecrated.
6

Accidental, adventitious.
E.
आङ्, रुह to ascend, causal form, part. past.

Length.
2

A woman's waist.
3 Ascent, rising. creeping up.
4 Mounting, riding.
5 The rider of a horse or elephant.
6

Weight.
7

A measure.
8 The buttocks.
9 A mine.
E.
आङ्, रुह to rise, to mount, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Lifting or raising up.
E.
आङ् before रुह, affix वुन्.

n. (-णं)
1 Rising, ascending.
2 The rising or growing of new shoots.
3 A ladder, a staircase.
4 Riding on.
E.
आङ्, रुह, to ascend, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
One who mounts or rides.
E.
आङ् before रुह to mount, णिनि aff.
